known_misread: remind_request is true beside the leads, and type is event rather than correction: the model reads "avisame 2 horas antes" as a request to be reminded of the event it names. Harmless as read, and either misread alone is too: leads beside a shown referent bind whatever the type (ADR-0046; TestI40_LeadsBindWhateverTheType replays this reading without its remind_request), and leads win over a stray request (ADR-0043; TestI40_LeadsWinOverAStrayRemindRequest replays it as recorded). No unit is stored and the user gets the item reminded 2 hours before
